text:
The constraints lock two blocks: Ben–Cara–Dev in three consecutive slots, and Hana–Ivo in two consecutive slots, with Ivo before Ben. Finn is before Hana with slot numbers at least 3 apart, so Hana starts at 4 or 5.

The only placement that also leaves a pair of free slots exactly two apart for Elif and Gus is Ben–Cara–Dev in 7–8–9 and Hana–Ivo in 5–6, with Finn in 1. Slots 2, 3, and 4 then go to Elif, Ann, and Gus: Elif before Ivo, exactly one slot between Elif and Gus, Ann before Gus, and Ann three slots from Ivo.

That filling meets every constraint, and every other block placement leaves no legal seats for the remaining three.
